series.name: Splits — InverterOn / Full DC / T3 (shared platform)
series.notes: PEL wall splits (InverterOn, Full DC, T3 heat/cool, WiFi T3 lines) share one display-code platform. No public PEL service manual / official error table found (pel.com.pk search returns transformer docs only). Core set (E0–E5/E8, F0–F9, FA, P2–P8) is documented identically by Electra Fix and Holife — confidence high as two agreeing technician sources. P1 and FF are field/video/title evidence only (confidence low). Electra Fix staff replied on the same page that 'PEL inverter EC error does not occur' — EC deliberately omitted. Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON. Support UAN: 042-111-102-103; WhatsApp 0300-1102103.

solutions.en: Power off at breaker and note whether cooling/heating still runs
solutions.ur: Breaker se power band karein aur dekhein ke cooling/heating chal rahi hai ya nahi

solutions.en: Technician should read the model's service chart for FF — do not guess the fault
solutions.ur: Technician model ki service chart se FF dekhe — fault andaza na lagayein

source.title: Fixya — My pel inverter ac showing FF error after sometime (user report)

notes.en: Confidence low: code is highlighted as common on PEL (Electra Fix title + Fixya user report of a PEL unit showing FF), but no source states the meaning — app must show the 'verify on your model' badge.
notes.ur: Confidence low: code PEL par common batayi gayi hai (Electra Fix title + Fixya user report jisme PEL unit par FF tha), lekin koi source meaning nahi batata — app par 'verify on your model' badge dikhana zaroori hai.
